title: read_wine_bot translations
description: Keys every locales/*.json file must have. Add a key to both properties and required, then to every locale file.

greeting.description: Reply to /start in a private chat, followed by one line per command in the command menu.

command.new.description: Description of /new, which starts a giveaway setup, in Telegram's command menu; starts with an emoji, up to 256 characters.

command.edit.description: Description of /edit, which starts editing the user's giveaway, in Telegram's command menu; starts with an emoji, up to 256 characters.

command.list.description: Description of /list, which lists the user's running giveaways, in Telegram's command menu; starts with an emoji, up to 256 characters.

command.language.description: Description of /language, which shows the language buttons, in Telegram's command menu; starts with an emoji, up to 256 characters.

command.cancel.description: Description of /cancel, which leaves any unfinished step, in Telegram's command menu; starts with an emoji, up to 256 characters.

command.cancelled.description: Reply to /cancel after the bot leaves any unfinished step.

language.prompt.description: Reply to /language, shown above the language buttons.

language.selected.description: Sent after a user taps a language button. %[1]s: the chosen language's button label.

giveaway.prompt.description: First setup step: asks the admin to forward the channel post or send its link.

giveaway.ask_end_date.description: Setup step: asks for the end date; the default, a week from today, is a button.

giveaway.ask_end_time.description: Setup step: asks for the end time in Kyiv time; the default is a button.

giveaway.ask_winners.description: Setup step: asks for the number of winners; the default is a button.

giveaway.ask_button_text.description: Setup step: asks for the join button text; the default is a button.

giveaway.invalid_date.description: Sent when the end date is not a YYYY-MM-DD date.

giveaway.date_in_past.description: Sent when the end date is before today in Kyiv.

giveaway.invalid_time.description: Sent when the end time is not an HH:MM time.

giveaway.time_in_past.description: Sent when the end date and time are not in the future.

giveaway.invalid_winners.description: Sent when the number of winners is not a whole number from 1 to 99.

giveaway.invalid_button_text.description: Sent when the join button text is empty or longer than 64 characters.

giveaway.summary.description: Last setup step, shown above Confirm and Cancel. %[1]s: t.me link to the post, %[2]s: end date and time, %[3]d: winners, %[4]s: join button text.

giveaway.confirm.description: Button under the summary that creates the giveaway.

giveaway.cancel.description: Button under every setup step that discards the setup.

giveaway.cancelled.description: Sent after the admin cancels the setup.

giveaway.outdated.description: Popup when a setup button belongs to a step that has passed.

giveaway.created.description: Sent after the join button is attached and the giveaway is saved.

giveaway.exists.description: Sent when the forwarder's own published or cancelled giveaway is on the forwarded post; points to the edit button.

giveaway.taken.description: Sent when another admin's published or cancelled giveaway is on the forwarded post.

giveaway.not_admin.description: Sent when the forwarder is not an admin of the post's channel.

giveaway.no_rights.description: Sent when the bot lacks the channel rights a giveaway needs; names both: Post messages and Edit messages of others.

giveaway.failed.description: Sent when the setup fails for another reason.

giveaway.button.description: Default label of the join button under the channel post.

giveaway.joined.description: Popup after a user taps the join button for the first time.

giveaway.already_joined.description: Popup after a user taps the join button again.

giveaway.join_failed.description: Popup when the tap could not be recorded.

draw.results.description: Header of the results reply to the giveaway post when there are several winners, above the winner links. Plain text: the bot escapes it for HTML.

draw.results_one.description: draw.results for exactly one winner. Plain text.

draw.congrats.description: Last line of the results when there are several winners, after the winner links and a blank line. Plain text: the bot escapes it for HTML.

draw.congrats_one.description: draw.congrats for exactly one winner. Plain text.

draw.no_winners.description: The whole results reply when the giveaway ended without winners. Plain text.

giveaway.ended.description: Popup when the tap comes at or after the giveaway's end time; nothing is recorded.

edit.prompt.description: Asks for the forwarded post, or its link, of the giveaway to edit.

edit.not_found.description: Sent when the forwarded post has no published or cancelled giveaway.

edit.not_yours.description: Sent when the giveaway on the forwarded post was created by another admin.

edit.finished.description: Sent when the giveaway's winners are recorded, so it can no longer change.

edit.not_admin.description: Sent when the creator is no longer an admin of the channel.

edit.no_rights.description: Sent when the bot cannot read the channel's admins or edit the post.

edit.failed.description: Sent when an edit fails for any other reason.

edit.menu.description: The field menu, HTML. %[1]s: status line, %[2]s: post link, %[3]s: end date in Kyiv, %[4]s: end time in Kyiv, %[5]d: winners, %[6]d: participant count, %[7]s: button text, %[8]s to %[11]s: the edit links of the date, time, winners and button text, %[12]s: the link that moves the giveaway to another post.

edit.status_published.description: Status line of a published giveaway in the field menu.

edit.status_cancelled.description: Status line of a cancelled giveaway in the field menu.

edit.status_draft.description: Status line of an unpublished draft in the field menu.

edit.link.description: Text of the link that changes a value, in the field menu and in /list. The whole text, brackets included, is the link.

edit.cancel_giveaway.description: Field menu button that cancels a published giveaway.

edit.publish_giveaway.description: Field menu button that publishes a cancelled giveaway again.

edit.ask_cancel.description: Asks to confirm cancelling the giveaway.

edit.no.description: Declines cancelling or finishing the giveaway.

edit.cancelled.description: Sent after the giveaway is cancelled.

edit.finish_giveaway.description: Field menu button that finishes a published giveaway now.

edit.ask_finish.description: Asks to confirm finishing the giveaway now.

edit.finishing.description: Sent after the end time is moved to now; the next winner draw finishes the giveaway.

edit.restored.description: Sent after a cancelled giveaway is published again.

edit.end_passed.description: Sent when a cancelled giveaway cannot be published because its end time has passed.

edit.date_time_in_past.description: Sent when a new end date is today but the giveaway's end time of day has already passed.

edit.stopped.description: Sent when the user stops an edit at the forward step.

edit.list.description: Header of the user's running giveaways.

edit.list_item.description: One giveaway as an HTML line. %[1]s: edit.list_mark_published, edit.list_mark_draft or edit.list_mark_gone, %[2]s: post link, %[3]s: edit link, %[4]s: end time in Kyiv with the edit.list_due, edit.list_draft or edit.list_gone suffix, %[5]d: participant count, %[6]s: edit.link.

edit.list_due.description: Appended to a running giveaway past its end time.

edit.list_draft.description: Appended to the end time of the user's unpublished draft in the list.

edit.list_mark_published.description: Emoji at the start of a published giveaway's line in the list.

edit.list_mark_draft.description: Emoji at the start of an unpublished draft's line in the list.

edit.list_mark_gone.description: Emoji at the start of the line of a running giveaway whose post was deleted.

edit.list_gone.description: Appended to the end time of a running giveaway whose post was deleted.

edit.list_gone_note.description: Note under the list when a post was deleted: participants are kept and the giveaway can move to another post of the channel.

edit.list_empty.description: Sent when the user has no running giveaways.

edit.move_prompt.description: Asks for the post to move the giveaway to.

edit.move_other_channel.description: Sent when the new post is in another channel.

edit.move_same.description: Sent when the new post is the giveaway's current post.

edit.move_taken.description: Sent when the new post already carries a giveaway.

edit.moved.description: Sent after the giveaway moved to another post.

edit.post_gone.description: Sent when the post to put the button on was deleted.

review.results.description: Header of the results review sent to the giveaway's creator after the draw, followed by one numbered line per winner. HTML. %[1]s: link to the giveaway post.

review.no_winners.description: Results review of a giveaway left without winners. HTML. %[1]s: link to the giveaway post.

review.reroll_button.description: Button under the results review that replaces one winner. %[1]d: the winner's place.

review.publish_button.description: Button under the results review that posts the results in the channel.

review.ask_reroll.description: Asks to confirm replacing a winner. HTML. %[1]d: the winner's place; %[2]s: link to the winner.

review.ask_publish.description: Asks to confirm posting the results in the channel.

review.yes_publish.description: Confirms posting the results in the channel.

review.published.description: Notice after the results were posted in the channel.

review.publish_failed.description: Notice when the channel refused the results; the review comes back below it.

review.published_partly.description: Notice when only the first part of long results reached the channel.

review.skip_button.description: Button under the results review that closes the giveaway without posting the results.

review.ask_skip.description: Asks to confirm closing the giveaway without posting the results.

review.yes_skip.description: Confirms closing the giveaway without posting the results.

review.skipped.description: Notice after the giveaway was closed without posting the results.

review.not_admin.description: Notice when someone who is not an admin of the giveaway's channel tries to review its results.

review.not_pending.description: Notice when a results link points to results already published or skipped.

review.channels.description: Line under the results review header that explains the subscription marks of the winners and lists every channel where the bot is an admin. HTML. %[1]s: the channels as links, joined with ' · '.

review.waiting.description: Silent notice to the creator, sent instead of the results review while a setup or edit step waits for input. HTML. %[1]s: link to the giveaway post.

edit.list_results.description: Line of /list for a giveaway whose results wait for review. HTML. %[1]s: mark emoji; %[2]s: link to the post; %[3]s: link that opens the results review.

edit.list_mark_results.description: Emoji at the start of the /list line of a giveaway whose results wait for review.

command.list_finished.description: Description of /list_finished, which lists the user's finished giveaways page by page, in Telegram's command menu; starts with an emoji, up to 256 characters.

finished.list.description: Header of /list_finished, followed by one line per finished giveaway.

finished.item.description: Line of /list_finished. HTML. %[1]d: number of the line across pages; %[2]s: link to the post; %[3]s: draw date and time in Kyiv; %[4]d: participant count; %[5]d: winner count.

finished.review.description: Ending of a /list_finished line whose results wait for review. HTML. %[1]s: link that opens the results review.

finished.empty.description: Reply to /list_finished when the user has no finished giveaways.

page.prev.description: Button under a paged list, /list or /list_finished, that shows the previous page. %[1]d: that page's number.

page.next.description: Button under a paged list, /list or /list_finished, that shows the next page. %[1]d: that page's number.
